hard_gates: Queue row is not a card.
Survey mention is recall evidence, not paper evidence.
No original paper PDF/HTML brief, no formal L1 card.
Formal L1 cards in notes/ root must pass scripts/autoresearch.py validate before being reported as complete.
Claim source must distinguish self-report / third-party replication / independent audit; do not mix them.
select_rules: Core contribution is an autoresearch pipeline mechanism, evaluation protocol, or documented failure mode.
Paper provides third-party replication or independent audit of prior autoresearch claims.
maybe_rules: General LLM agent method with a meaningful research-task evaluation section.
move_elsewhere_rules: Core contribution is a generic RL / agent training method — belongs in agentic-rl/ or agent-data/.
Core contribution is a foundation model recipe with only incidental research-task eval — belongs in foundation-model-systems/.
